entries.title: DFE (FCN Base) - Dewarping Document Image By Displacement Flow Estimation with Fully Convolutional Network (2021)
entries.summary: This paper introduces a fully convolutional network that estimates dense displacement flow fields to rectify warped document images, enabling accurate dewarping for improved text recognition.

entries.title: DocTr - Document Image Transformer for Geometric Unwarping and Illumination Correction (2021)
entries.summary: The paper presents DocTr, a transformer-based approach that performs geometric unwarping and illumination correction on document images, aiming to address the challenges associated with dewarped document images.

entries.title: Rectinet - A Gated and Bifurcated Stacked U-Net Module for Document Image Dewarping (2020)
entries.summary: The paper introduces Rectinet, a Gated and Bifurcated Stacked U-Net module designed to correct geometric distortions (dewarping) in scanned document images, improving downstream OCR performance.

entries.title: Multistage Curvilinear Coordinate Transform Based Document Image Dewarping using a Novel Quality Estimator (2020)
entries.summary: The paper introduces a multistage curvilinear coordinate transform combined with a novel quality estimator to effectively dewarp document images, enhancing subsequent analysis and recognition tasks.

entries.title: 10. DewarpNet - Single-Image Document Unwarping With Stacked 3D and 2D Regression Networks (2019)
entries.summary: The paper introduces DewarpNet, a stacked 3D‑2D regression network that predicts per‑pixel warp maps to restore the original geometry of scanned documents, enabling accurate text extraction and downstream analysis.

entries.title: Docuwarp (2019)
entries.summary: Docuwarp (2019) presents a technique for dewarping curved document photographs, using geometric correction and image warping to restore the original flat layout of text pages, improving document analysis accuracy.

entries.title: DocUNet: Document Image Unwarping via a Stacked U-Net (2018)
entries.summary: DocUNet presents a stacked U-Net architecture that effectively restores warped document images to flat, legible form, improving OCR performance on scanned texts.

entries.title: Robust Document Image Dewarping Method Using Text-Lines and Line Segments (2017)
entries.summary: We document the *Image Dewarping Dataset for Document Images* from the paper, which provides real-world examples of distorted scanned documents (e.g., books, forms) with corresponding dewarped references. This dataset specifically underpins the 'Robust Document Image Dewarping Method' proposed in 2017, containing paired distorted and corrected document images for quantitative evaluation of dewarping algorithms.

entries.title: Document dewarping via text-line based optimization (2015)
entries.summary: This 2015 research paper introduces a text-line based optimization technique for dewarping document images, aiming to restore distorted pages into a readable, flat layout by aligning text lines and correcting geometric distortions.

entries.id: A novel model-based dewarping technique for advanced Digital Library systems (2014)
entries.title: A novel model-based dewarping technique for advanced Digital Library systems (2014)
entries.summary: The paper introduces a model-based approach to dewarping captured images of books in digital library applications, proposing a technique to correct geometric distortions for improved document digitization.

entries.title: A Model-based Book Dewarping Method Using Text Line Detection (2007)
entries.summary: This 2007 paper proposes a model-based dewarping technique for books by detecting text lines in images to correct geometric distortion, facilitating accurate OCR of skewed book pages.

entries.title: Dewarping of document image by global optimization (2005)
entries.summary: The paper introduces a global optimization method to correct geometric distortions in document images, enhancing dewarping accuracy through systematic image processing techniques.

entries.title: RectiNet-v2 - A stacked network architecture for document image dewarping
entries.summary: RectiNet-v2 introduces a stacked network architecture specifically designed for document image dewarping, correcting distortions in curved or warped document pages to produce flat, distortion-free images suitable for downstream OCR tasks.

entries.title: TADoc: Robust Time-Aware Document Image Dewarping
entries.authors: Fangmin Zhao, Weichao Zeng, Zhenhang Li, Dongbao Yang, Yu Zhou
entries.summary: The paper introduces TADoc, a robust, time-aware framework designed to dewarp document images captured under varying temporal conditions, ensuring accurate text rendering and layout preservation.

entries.title: OCRGenBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating OCR Generative Capabilities
entries.authors: Peirong Zhang, Haowei Xu, Jiaxin Zhang, Xuhan Zheng, Guitao Xu, Yuyi Zhang, Junle Liu, Zhenhua Yang, Wei Zhou, Lianwen Jin
entries.summary: OCRGenBench একটি মানদণ্ডীয় বেঞ্চমার্ক যা OCR‑এর জেনারেটিভ ক্ষমতার সঠিক মূল্যায়ন করতে ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে; এতে ফন্ট, স্ক্যানিং শিফট এবং বায়োস্ক্যানের মতো ভিন্ন পatterns ম~max করা হয়।

entries.summary: The paper introduces D2Dewarp, a dual‑dimensional geometric representation learning framework that dewarps document images, enabling accurate geometric normalization for downstream document layout analysis and OCR tasks.

entries.authors: Weiguang Zhang, Huangcheng Lu, Maizhen Ning, Xiaowei Huang, Wei Wang, Kaizhu Huang, Qiufeng Wang
entries.summary: The paper introduces DvD, a generative diffusion model that dewarps document images by operating directly on coordinate representations, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on dewarping tasks.
